$description.en_us: Actions an entity performs on itself.
$description.zh_cn: 实体对自身执行的行为。

$description.en_us: Entity Action selected by a type identifier.
Adds to a resource the entity holds.
$description.zh_cn: 增加实体持有的某项资源。

$description.en_us: One curse, with how many stacks and how long.
$description.zh_cn: 一条诅咒，含层数与持续时长。

$description.en_us: Removes every curse carrying the given tag.
$description.zh_cn: 移除带有指定标签的全部诅咒。

$description.en_us: Edits a data component on the entity's item.
$description.zh_cn: 修改实体物品上的数据组件。

$description.en_us: Adds exhaustion, the way sprinting does.
$description.zh_cn: 增加饥饿消耗，效果类似疾跑。

$description.en_us: Gives an item to the entity.
Sets the entity's accumulated fall distance.
$description.zh_cn: 设置实体已累计的坠落距离。

$description.en_us: Turns gravity off for the entity.
Runs the child action with the given probability.
$description.zh_cn: 按给定概率执行子行为。

$description.en_us: Runs one of two actions, depending on a condition.
$description.zh_cn: 按条件在两个行为中选择一个执行。

$description.en_us: Picks one child action from a weighted list.
$description.zh_cn: 从加权列表中随机挑选一个子行为。
发出一个原版游戏事件。

$description.en_us: Runs an action on the entity's passengers.
$description.zh_cn: 对实体的乘客执行行为。

$description.en_us: Runs a block action at the entity's position.
$description.zh_cn: 在实体所在位置执行方块行为。

$description.en_us: Runs a bi-entity action with the entity as both actor and target.
$description.zh_cn: 把实体自身同时当作执行者与目标，执行双实体行为。

$description.en_us: Runs an item action on the item the entity holds.
$description.zh_cn: 对实体持有的物品执行物品行为。

$description.en_us: Runs an action on the vehicle the entity rides.
$description.zh_cn: 对实体骑乘的载具执行行为。
